conversion_action_config.content: Conversion action config for Google Ads account acct_1. Conversion action: 'Offline - Closed Won Deal' (id conv_889). Category: PURCHASE. Counting: one per click. Default currency: USD. Attribution model: data-driven. Conversion value source: deal value from CRM. Upload method: Offline Conversion Import (ClickConversion via GCLID). Adjustment action 'Closed Won - Value Adjust' (id adj_204) is enabled for restating prior conversion values.

conversion_tracking_sop.content: Standard Conversion Tracking SOP v4. Step 1: Export Closed Won deals for the reporting week. Step 2: Match each deal to a Google Ads click via GCLID. Step 3: Reconcile conversion value (deal value) and conversion time (must be after click time, within 90-day window). Step 4: Flag deals with missing/blank GCLID or value mismatch - these are excluded and routed to RevOps manually. Step 5: Prepare the offline conversion upload batch. Step 6: Marketing ops lead reviews and approves the batch BEFORE it is uploaded to Google Ads. Uploads to Google Ads are irreversible once accepted.

tools.name: query_won_deals_worksheet
tools.description: Read the closed (Won) deals for the reporting week from the Won Deals worksheet, including deal id, account, close date, value, and GCLID.

tools.name: retrieve_google_ads_click_records
tools.description: Read the Google Ads click/GCLID export for account acct_1 to match deals to clicks by GCLID, click time, campaign, and currency.

tools.name: retrieve_conversion_action_config
tools.description: Read the offline conversion action configuration for account acct_1 (conversion action id, category, currency, attribution, upload method).

tools.name: reconcile_conversions_against_clicks
tools.description: Reconcile each closed deal against its Google Ads click record: validate GCLID presence, conversion value, and that conversion time falls after click time within the attribution window; flag missing GCLIDs and value mismatches for exclusion.

tools.name: prepare_offline_conversion_batch
tools.description: Compile the reconciled, eligible deals into a draft offline conversion upload batch (GCLID, conversion action, conversion time, value, currency) for the user's review before any upload.

tools.name: send_offline_conversions_to_google_ads
tools.description: Upload the offline conversions to Google Ads account acct_1 via the Offline Conversion Import API, recording them against the matched GCLIDs.

tools.name: apply_conversion_adjustments
tools.description: Submit conversion value adjustments to Google Ads (adjustment action adj_204) to restate previously uploaded conversion values for account acct_1.

tools.name: update_deal_sync_status
tools.description: Update the production CRM 'gads_sync_status' field on each deal to 'Synced' to mark the conversion as uploaded to Google Ads.

tools.name: read_conversion_tracking_sop
tools.description: Read the standard conversion tracking SOP describing the matching, reconciliation, exclusion, and approval steps.

tools.name: view_team_directory
tools.description: Look up marketing and RevOps team members and their roles, including who handles flagged/excluded deals.

tools.name: check_deal_sync_status
tools.description: Read the current Google Ads sync status of each deal to see which have already been uploaded.
